name: Verona
title: Crown of Wandering Leaves
description: A ranger who walks the long roads alone, drawn always to the places where the land remembers something. She carries Xochi — a sword of earth, found by accident, kept by something more. She would say she's just looking for answers. The forest, when it speaks of her, says otherwise.

swordRanks.title: The Swamp Walker
swordRanks.description: A solo ranger is moving through the murky swamp. She seems to know more about this island than she should.

stages.objective: Find Verona in the murky swamp
unavailable_dialogue: She's deeper in the swamp. Keep going.
intro_dialogue: Most people don't bother with the swamp.
I'm Verona. I've been on Ashenfall for about three weeks.
Following something. Don't have a better word for it yet.
You pulled a sword out of the ground near the beach settlement, didn't you.
I've been looking at the sites on this island for two weeks.
None of them moved for me.
success_dialogue: This island sits on top of something old.
A lot of places do — places where powerful things happened, or gathered, or chose to be.
Ashenfall has more of these sites than anywhere I've been.
Whatever was buried here, there was a lot of it.
And it's waking up.
The swords are how it wakes up.
You're how it wakes up.
I don't know why yet. But I want to find out.
Stay accessible. I'll have more when I've worked through it.

swordRanks.title: Xochi
swordRanks.description: Verona has been carrying a sword she found on her travels. She doesn't know what it is. She's about to find out.

stages.objective: Return to Verona in the swamp
intro_dialogue: I've been carrying this sword for eight months.
Found it in the jungle, two maps east of here.
It was just — there. In the ground. Glowing faintly.
It's been humming since I got to Ashenfall.
I think I need to actually — hold it. Properly. Not just carry it.
Will you stay? In case something happens.
success_dialogue: Oh.
Oh that's —
I can feel the ground.
Not just under my feet. All of it. The roots. The water table. The thing that grows.
I've always been good with plants. With earth. With knowing where to step.
I thought that was just — skill. Experience.
It's not, is it.
This sword was mine the whole time.
I just hadn't held it right yet.
Her name is Xochi.
I don't know how I know that.
I just do.

swordRanks.title: What the Tree Holds
swordRanks.description: Verona has something for the player. And something to say about the Dragon Shrine before they get there.

unavailable_dialogue: I want to get this right before I say it.
intro_dialogue: And something to tell you first.
success_dialogue: There's a shrine in the mountains. Dragon Shrine, people call it.
There's a tree there. Dragonblood Tree. Older than anything else standing on this island.
It's a stabilising force — the island's substrate runs through it the way water runs through roots.
If it gets cut down, the island doesn't collapse. But it destabilises.
The sword sites get more volatile. The discharge patches spread.
Whoever's up there might ask you to cut it.
I'm not telling you what to do.
I'm telling you what it is so you know what you're deciding.
The tree will grow back. The question is what happens in between.
Now.
This is for you.
It'll get you through the swamp paths and up toward the shrine.
Go carefully. There's someone up there worth meeting.
And someone worth watching carefully.
